data.summary: Online banking or the FNB app, exported as CSV.
steps: Log in to FNB Online Banking on a computer.
Open My Bank Accounts and pick the account.
Choose Transaction History, set the date range, then Download and select CSV.
Sign in to Standard Bank Internet Banking.
Select your account and open Transaction History.
Pick the period you want and choose Export, then CSV.

data.summary: Absa online banking, exported as CSV.
steps: Go to Accounts and choose the account.
Open Transaction History, choose the dates and click Export as CSV.
Sign in to Nedbank Money on the web.
Select your account and open Transactions.
Filter by date, then use Download and choose CSV.

data.summary: Capitec app or internet banking, exported as CSV.
steps: Log in to Capitec internet banking on a computer.
Open your account and choose Transaction History.
Select the date range and download the statement as CSV.
